description: This PHP source file contains a PHPUnit test class named EmployeeEventServiceTest, which tests the EmployeeEventService class's methods related to employee event management within the OrangeHRM system. The tests focus on saving employee events, retrieving user roles, and fetching employee events from the database, utilizing mock objects for dependencies.

classes.name: EmployeeEventServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing EmployeeEventService methods within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeEvent
methods.description: Tests the saveEmployeeEvent method to ensure it correctly saves an EmployeeEvent and returns the expected event ID.

methods.name: testSaveEvent
methods.description: Tests the saveEvent method for creating and saving an employee event with proper attributes and roles.

methods.name: testGetUserRole
methods.description: Verifies that getUserRole correctly retrieves the role name of the current user or defaults to 'System'.

methods.name: getUserRoleDataProvider
methods.description: Provides test data for testing getUserRole with different user role scenarios.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeEvents
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of employee events via getEmployeeEvents method.
